method.blink: -median(TP9,TP10,AUX) 0.5-8 Hz, positive pulse >= max(3 robust sd, 25 uV), FWHM 50-500 ms, all three far channels >= half the pulse; mirror = same on the sign-flipped signal, outside 0.5 s of a blink, per minute of blink-free time
method.frontal: mean(AF7,AF8) 0.5-8 Hz, positive pulse >= 3 robust sd on both channels within 100 ms, FWHM 50-500 ms (as specified; at the noise floor on this montage)
method.horizontal: |AF7-AF8| 0.5-15 Hz peaks >= max(3 robust sd, 20 uV), 150 ms apart, not within 150 ms of a blink; after_change = within 0.6 s of a lit/dark edge
method.slow: 0.1-0.5 Hz power in 20 s Hann segments, median per window, log10 uV^2
method.artifacts: two or more channels > 150 uV (1-40 Hz) or a railed sample, +-1 s, excluded
method.uncertainty: block bootstrap over 30 s blocks (2000 draws), Theil-Sen 95 % slope intervals, sign-flip permutation over paired 1-min bins
